name: Castle War
subtitle: Two castles, one valley
description: Ravensmere (a Greek city-state of white marble, hoplites and triremes) on the left and Ironvale (a Roman legion fort of red brick, legionaries and quinqueremes) on the right. Each castle stands in a moat with one bridge at its gate, has walls and four towers, archers on the walls and towers, and palisades in front of the gate. Troops muster in the courtyards and sally out when the enemy comes near. Catapults and trebuchets walk out with the army and batter the enemy walls, gates, towers and palisades. A side that gathers a strong force in the middle marches on the enemy's keep. Nobody wins: the battle goes on for as long as the program runs. Trenches and old craters scar the middle of the field and give archers cover.

objectives.text: Ravensmere: take the keep of Ironvale
Ironvale: take the keep of Ravensmere

actions.text: Siege engines roll out behind the fifth wave.
Both castles bring up a catapult.
Both castles raise a trebuchet behind their walls.
Ravensmere sallies out through the west gate!
The garrison of Ravensmere marches out of the west gate, bows in hand.
The west gate of Ravensmere is shut again.
Ironvale sallies out through the east gate!
The garrison of Ironvale marches out of the east gate, bows in hand.
The east gate of Ironvale is shut again.
Ravensmere marches on the keep of Ironvale!
Ironvale marches on the keep of Ravensmere!
